description: Qibla bearings (degrees clockwise from true North) and distances to the Kaaba (21.4225 N, 39.8262 E) for the 7 prayer-golden cities (10_TESTING §4). Tolerance ±0.5° on the bearing (both sources), ±1 % on the distance (our spherical figure vs the ellipsoidal one).

sources.aladhan: Independent calculator 1: the Aladhan Qibla API — GET https://api.aladhan.com/v1/qibla/<lat>/<lng>, field data.direction; queried 13 Nov 2026 (spherical great circle).
sources.geographiclib: Independent calculator 2: GeographicLib 2.0 (C. F. F. Karney), Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(lat, lng, 21.4225, 39.8262) — azi1 mod 360 and s12 / 1000; computed 13 Nov 2026 (WGS84 ellipsoid).
